declarations.description:
"Later today · Tomorrow · Next week · Pick a date and time…": a menu of quick times, as Gmail's snooze, Slack's
reminders and Linear's "remind me" offer. Each row shows the time it falls at, in the locale's hour cycle.

The default rows are Later today (in about 3 hours, on the hour; hidden from `evening`), This evening (at
`evening`, hidden from an hour before), Tomorrow, This weekend (hidden on weekends) and Next week (the first working
day of the next week), the last three at `morning`. `presets` replaces them with rows of your own, each
`{ id, label, at }` where `at` is a function of the current instant or an expression such as `+3h`, `+30m`,
`tomorrow 09:00`, `next monday 09:00`, `saturday 10:00` or `end of day`; a row that does not apply now, or falls
outside `min`/`max`, is hidden. The last row, "Pick a date and time…", swaps the list for a `c2-date-time-picker`
in place, with Back and Set.

The value is a wall-clock `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` in `time-zone`, the shape `c2-date-time-picker` uses, and
`valueAsDate` is the instant it names. A row is resolved when it is picked, so "Tomorrow" means the day after the
click. A pick fires `input`, `change` and `time-select` (with the preset's `id`).

The trigger shows `label` until a time is chosen, then that time; a separate clear button sits beside it
(`clearable="false"` removes it). Slot your own trigger into `trigger`; the component never writes attributes on it,
so give it `aria-haspopup="menu"` yourself and keep its `aria-expanded` in step from `menu-toggle` (or read
`expanded`, and style through `:state(open)`). `inline` draws the list without a trigger or popover, to sit inside
another menu, a sheet or a card.

It is a form control: under a `name` the form receives the value, `required` asks for one, and it takes part in
`c2-form-field`. The list is a `menu` of `menuitemradio` rows (the chosen one checked) with arrow keys, Home, End
and first-letter typeahead. `now` fixes the current time for tests and demos.
declarations.name: QuickTimeMenu

cssProperties.description: Text and icon of a trigger showing a chosen time.
cssProperties.name: --c2-quick-time-menu__trigger__set--color

cssProperties.description: While an enclosing `c2-form-field` shows an error.
cssProperties.name: --c2-quick-time-menu__trigger__error--border

cssParts.description: The clear button beside the trigger.
cssParts.name: clear

cssParts.description: The surface holding the list or the date and time panel.
cssParts.name: menu

slots.description: Replaces the built-in trigger button: an element that opens the menu (a `c2-button`, a `c2-icon-button`, a plain `<button>`).
slots.name: trigger

members.name: value
members.description: The chosen time as a wall-clock `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` in `time-zone`, or empty.

members.name: name
members.description: The form field name.

members.name: label
members.description: The trigger's text and the menu's name, such as "Snooze until"; "Pick a time" by default.

members.name: presets
members.description: Rows of your own, replacing the defaults: `{ id, label, at }`. Set functions as a property; expressions also work as JSON.

members.name: now
members.description: The current time, for tests and demos: a `Date`, a timestamp or an ISO string. The browser's clock when unset.

members.name: morning
members.description: Time of day of Tomorrow, This weekend, Next week and expressions without a time.

members.name: evening
members.description: Time of day of This evening and `end of day`; Later today is hidden from then on.

members.name: timeZone
members.description: IANA time zone the value is read in, such as `Europe/Paris`; empty is the browser's zone.

members.name: min
members.description: Earliest time a row may fall at, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm`, or a date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) for the start of that day.

members.name: max
members.description: Latest time a row may fall at, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm`, or a date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) for any time that day.

members.name: inline
members.description: Draws the list in place, without a trigger or popover.

members.name: clearable
members.description: Shows the clear button beside the trigger once a time is chosen; `clearable="false"` removes it.

members.name: required
members.description: A time must be chosen.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns the trigger off; a disabled menu is not submitted.

members.name: valueAsDate
members.description: The instant the value names in `time-zone`, or `null` when empty.

members.name: expanded
members.description: True while the menu is open. Also the custom state `:state(open)`.

members.name: showMenu
members.description: Opens the menu. Does nothing inline or while disabled.

members.name: hideMenu
members.description: Closes the menu.

members.name: rows
members.description: The rows that apply now, each with the time it resolves to.

members.name: emit
members.description: Fires `input` and `change`, then `time-select` for a pick (`preset` undefined for a clear).

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (a pick or a clear).

events.name: change
events.description: The value changed (a pick or a clear).

events.name: time-select
events.description: A time was picked: `detail.value` and `detail.preset` (the preset's `id`, or `null` from the date and time panel).

events.name: menu-toggle
events.description: The menu opened or closed: `detail.open`. A slotted trigger updates its own `aria-expanded` from it.
